title: GENDIS: Gender-Related Discourse and Stance in Multilingual YouTube Comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on a human-annotated dataset of multilingual YouTube comments to detect gender-related discourse and classify its evaluative stance as negative (which includes hostile and benevolent sexism, stereotypes, and objectification), positive, or neutral.
Disaggregating and comparing model performance (macro-F1 scores) across English, local non-English monolingual, and code-mixed comments to measure model degradation on non-English texts.

Measuring cross-country transfer performance using leave-one-country-out (LOCO) cross-validation to evaluate how well models trained on gendered speech in two countries generalize to a held-out third country (India, Kenya, Nigeria).
